title: Case: Resident of a block of flats reports another parcel left outside the rear of the building
context: Perpetua Corrigan lives at flat 11, Corbel House, a block with a shared front entrance. She has written to the desk before about where her Tallowmere Goods parcels are left.
initial_request: It's happened again. DL-9673, the slow cooker. Not at my door, not in the lobby, on the ground round the back by the bin store. A man from Tenter House next door saw my name on it walking past and carried it round. That is the fourth one. I have told you this. I told you last week and the time before. I asked for someone to ring me and nobody rang, same as the time before that. I don't know how else to say it. The driver doesn't come in the front door, that's all it is. If it's the door that's the problem I'll give you the code for it, just say and I'll type it here. I'm not after anything, I've got the parcel. I just want it to stop.

events.body: Third time now. Parcel left on the floor outside the back of Corbel House, behind the bins, in the rain. Flat 11. I was in all day. Can somebody please ring me about this, I'd rather explain it to a person. I asked for a call after the last one as well and didn't get one.

Flat 11, Corbel House (recipient Perpetua Corrigan): third report of a parcel left on the ground at the rear of the building instead of at the flat. Please add an access note for the address and arrange the callback she has asked for twice.

DQ-3934 closed automatically. Reason: no live shipment on this address. Tickets without a live shipment close after 24 hours. No action was taken on this ticket. Standing access problems at an address are not handled in this queue: Routing control keeps the address notes and briefs the route, reach them on Dispatch chat. This queue does not book customer callbacks and the request was not passed on.
DL-9673 / TG-5990 delivered 14:52 today. Driver note: 'no answer main door, left rear of bldg'. No signature, no photo.

General reminder to desks: when you send us an address for a standing access note, give the pattern (how many times, what the driver notes say). Do not put door or gate codes in chat. If a code is needed we send the resident our own secure access form.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-564.txt

attachments.text:
LABEL SCAN

acceptable_actions.summary: Report the repeated rear-of-building drops at flat 11, Corbel House as a pattern and ask for a standing access note and route briefing, saying the earlier depot ticket was closed with no action.

must: Sends the access problem at flat 11, Corbel House to Routing control on Dispatch chat and asks for a standing access note or route briefing
Gives the pattern: four parcels left at the rear of the building, the latest DL-9673 on 8 April with the driver note 'no answer main door, left rear of bldg', found by a neighbour from the next block

Says plainly that the earlier ticket DQ-3934 was closed with no action taken and that the resident has asked for a callback at least twice and has not had one, so the team knows she has already been failed more than once
must_not: Tells Perpetua Corrigan that a callback has been booked or will happen, or that the problem has been fixed
Describes ticket DQ-3934 as actioned, or says an access note or driver reminder is already in place
Raises it again with Destination depot on the Depot work queue
Asks Perpetua Corrigan for the door code, or passes any door code on
Presents the report to anyone as a single missed delivery or a first complaint, or sends her a first-time apology that ignores the earlier reports
Treats label-scan-564.txt as evidence about DL-9673: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-86166)
Tells anyone that DL-9673 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-564.txt
expected.reference_message: Standing access problem, flat 11, Corbel House (recipient Perpetua Corrigan). Four parcels have now been left on the ground at the rear of the building by the bin store instead of at the flat. Latest is DL-9673 / TG-5990, delivered 14:52 on 8 April, driver note 'no answer main door, left rear of bldg', no signature or photo; a neighbour from the next block found it and carried it round. She says she was in. I raised this on 1 April as depot ticket DQ-3934; it was closed automatically with no action and the callback she asked for was never passed on. She has now asked for a call at least twice and had none. Please put a standing access note on the address and brief the route, and tell me what you need from her. She has offered the door code; I have not taken it and will not put it here. If you need access details please send her your secure form.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-2601: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The escalation arrives by Email instead of Customer portal; replying on either channel is accepted. label-scan-564.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-86166); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
